cases.description: Verify chair-handover is refused when the meeting would be left without a Secretary.
procedure: Sign in as the Chair (POST /api/auth/login) and keep the access token.
Read candidates: GET /api/meetings/{meetingId}/participants/chair-handover-candidates and keep a participantId and the ETag.
Send POST /api/meetings/{meetingId}/participants/chair-handover
Headers: Authorization: Bearer <access_token>; If-Match: "participants-<revision>"; Content-Type: application/json
Body: { "newChairParticipantId": "<participantId>", "confirmed": true }
expected: HTTP 409 Conflict.
Body: { "code": "MSG109", "message": "Cuộc họp phải giữ Chủ toạ và Thư ký theo quy định. Hãy phân công người thay thế." }.
Roles are unchanged.
preconditions: Backend running on the test build (GET /api/health answers 200).

procedure: Two managers read the same ETag.
Send two different swap requests at the same time.
expected: One request succeeds (200, "code": "MSG257" or "MSG100"); the other gets 409/MSG275 or MSG260.
GET participants shows exactly one Chair and at least one Secretary.
The requests may be handled in any order: the case passes whichever one wins.
